dogecoin.text: @hubdotxyz I would choose Dogecoin as a reserve currency because, despite its meme origins, it has developed a solid community and real-world use in online transactions and tipping. And unlike Bitcoin, Dogecoin has an unlimited supply. This means there's no maximum limit.

@hubdotxyz I would choose Dogecoin, as it's a topic of debate in the cryptocurrency world as a store of value. Although it initially began as a meme cryptocurrency, it has gained considerable attention and market capitalization, raising the question of its potential as a store of value.
